segments.speaker: Lena Fischer
segments.text: Let's review the new settings page. The goal was to cut the number of tabs from nine to five.

segments.speaker: Jenna Kim
segments.text: I like the grouping. Notifications and integrations feel much easier to find now.

segments.speaker: Marcus Lee
segments.text: One concern is the danger zone. Deleting the workspace is too close to the export button.

segments.speaker: Lena Fischer
segments.text: Good catch. I'll move delete into its own section with a confirmation step.

segments.speaker: Jenna Kim
segments.text: We also need to check the mobile layout, the tabs overflow on small screens.

segments.speaker: Marcus Lee
segments.text: I can build a quick prototype of the mobile version by Friday.

segments.speaker: Lena Fischer
segments.text: Perfect. Let's review again next week with the updated mocks.
